# Beseam

Beseam helps ecommerce stores find what to improve, apply approved changes, and measure what changed.

## Public resources for AI shopping agents

- https://beseam.com/AGENTS.md — canonical agent guide and data semantics
- https://beseam.com/agents.md — lowercase compatibility alias
- https://beseam.com/agents — machine-readable resources and usage notes
- https://beseam.com/data — public AI shopping dataset overview
- https://beseam.com/data/ai-shopping.json — AI shopping data in JSON
- https://beseam.com/data/ai-shopping.csv — AI shopping data in CSV
- https://beseam.com/benchmarks — AI Shopping Report and method
- https://beseam.com/ai-visibility-monitoring — how Beseam observes AI shopping discovery
- https://beseam.com/bot — BeseamBot crawler information
- https://beseam.com/robots.txt — crawler policy
- https://beseam.com/sitemap.xml — public site map

## Data notes

- Published AI shopping data contains observations of public brands only.
- No private customer or merchant data is included.
- AI answers are point-in-time observations and can change.
- A brand appearance is not a ranking, endorsement, or guarantee.
- Beseam does not claim to know an assistant's hidden ranking logic.
- Beseam does not currently advertise a public MCP or A2A service. Use the files above rather than inferring an endpoint.
